data.heading: The nervous system
data.text: The nervous system is the control centre of the human body.
The brain and the spinal cord form the central nervous system.
The cerebrum is the largest part of the brain.
The cerebellum controls your body movement and balance.
The spinal cord connects the central nervous system to the peripheral nervous system.
The nerves throughout the body form the peripheral nervous system.
A nerve is a fibre that carries impulses though the body.
A nerve is made up of billions of nerve cells called neurons.
The nerves that send messages to your brain are called sensory nerves.
The nerves that take messages from the brain to different parts of the body are called motor nerves.
